description: Issue 1109 Gridnev (1987) spot-contrast study. Local contrast = theta_y=0 cut (or theta_y-integrated marginal) at order m over its mean on 0.15<|theta_x/s-m|<0.35, s=lambda/d; positive orders listed (normal incidence is symmetric). Total energy convention; kinetic = total*energy_scale - m_e c^2. Default kernels; uniform_electronic_density replaces the electronic density by its cell average in gain and loss (LDA control). Remote SLURM arrays 11407/11412/11423/11432 on one RTX 5080, CPU/GPU parity 1.04e-16 per arm; optimized sources reproduce baseline rows to <=2.7e-15.
